claim_a: GLEAM life-cycle intensities for E and SE Asia (2005): pork 6.15, broilers 5.18, mixed beef 54.5 kg CO2e per kg carcass (FUF-04; FUF-05)
claim_b: FAOSTAT farm-gate intensities for Viet Nam (2023): pig 1.62, chicken 0.90, cattle 40.0, buffalo 65.0 kg CO2e per kg meat (FUF-10)
position_taken: GLEAM used: funders compare life-cycle footprints, and feed is most of the pork and poultry footprint. FAOSTAT kept as a boundary check.
notes: Not averaged. Both agree that ruminant meat is about 9 to 70 times more intensive per kg than pork or chicken.

topic: Emission intensity of meat: carcass or protein basis
claim_a: GLEAM per kg carcass with the package's 0.15 kg protein per kg carcass gives about 9.9 kg CO2e per kg carcass for the 2035 mix (FUF-04; FUF-05; DMA-001)
claim_b: Poore and Nemecek global means per kg protein (pig 76, poultry 57, beef herd 499) give about 1.6 times more for the same displaced protein (FUF-07)
position_taken: GLEAM on the package's carcass basis is the central value; Poore and Nemecek sets the high bound.
notes: The package's 0.15 protein factor is above GLEAM's implied 0.118 (pig) and 0.139 (chicken), which explains part of the gap.

topic: Emission intensity of meat: regional or global literature
claim_a: GLEAM regional values for E and SE Asia, higher because of lower productivity and soy land-use change (FUF-04; FUF-05)
claim_b: Heller et al. apply global LCA-literature averages to Vietnam: beef 33 kg CO2e per kg boneless, 6 times pork and 9.8 times poultry; regional factors raise diet totals by 14 to 22% (FUF-06)
position_taken: Regional GLEAM values used; they model the production systems Vietnam has.
notes: Different functional units (carcass against boneless edible).

claim_a: ACE's estimate for Sinergia Animal (Argentina, Colombia, Indonesia, 2023): 134,000 animals for 998,000 meals, about 0.134 animals per meal (AFN-26)
claim_b: Our Vietnamese estimate: about 0.020 animals per meal at the national meat mix, 0.0016 for a pork dish and 0.055 for a chicken dish (our calculation, FUF-03)
position_taken: Both kept. ACE's rate should not be applied to Vietnam; the gap comes from Vietnam's pork-heavy mix and probably from fish and species weighting in ACE's expert estimate.
notes: ACE's method used an external expert (Welfare Footprint Project); details not read.

claim_a: Package balance model: 1,821 kt poultry carcass produced in 2025 (NSO live weight x 0.70), implying about 2.2 kg per bird on FAOSTAT head counts (BLA-031)
claim_b: FAOSTAT 2024: chicken plus duck meat 1,424 kt, 1.83 kg per chicken (FUF-03)
position_taken: FAOSTAT per-bird yields used with their 2022 to 2024 range (1.83 to 2.36 kg); flagged for the balance model.
notes: Affects bird counts by up to about 15%.

topic: Is textured soy 'innovative protein' for market-shaping funders?
claim_a: The funder actor paper reads Nova Vista's procurement lever as a possible route for domestic textured protein (AFN-Q04)
claim_b: Nova Vista's RFP defines innovative proteins as 'primarily plant-based meat, fermentation-derived protein, and cultivated meat' and excludes whole-food plant-based work (AFN-05)
position_taken: Classed partial: textured soy is a plant-based meat ingredient but not named; only the funder can settle it (open question).

claim_a: Feed-grade soy protein concentrate 0.61 to 0.85 kg CO2e per kg, about 0.9 to 1.3 per kg protein (FUF-08, preprint)
claim_b: Tofu 19.75 kg CO2e per kg protein; other pulses 8.36 (FUF-07)
position_taken: Other pulses used as a labelled central proxy; the range spans both.
notes: No food-grade textured soy LCA found; the net CO2e of routes that displace meat changes by at most about 20%.
